content: SwiftData iOS 27 added sectionBy, ResultsObserver, Codable attributes, but ModelActor still runs on main thread unexpectedly, Codable attrs not usable in predicates/migrations, no clear perf gain. GRDB 7 (Jan 2025) has full Swift 6 support; recommended for data-heavy/control-heavy apps. For a headless-testable pure-domain game, versioned Codable JSON profile is simpler; GRDB is the upgrade path.
